site.name: The Payments Atlas
site.tagline: An interactive showcase of Canadian municipal payment patterns
site.sandboxBanner: Sandbox · Mocked provider · No real money moves · No real personal data

footer.neutralNote: A vendor-neutral educational resource. Not a payment processor.

home.heroSubtitle: The clerk-driven pay-by-link pattern. Citizen gets an SMS or email, taps a single link, authorizes inside their bank's app, and the bill reconciles automatically — without anyone typing a card number or guessing a memo field.
home.scenarioDescription: A municipal court clerk sends a payable link to a citizen for an unpaid traffic ticket. The citizen pays from their own banking app. The fine is marked paid in the clerk dashboard within seconds.

clerk.title: Clerk dashboard
clerk.subtitle: Create a payable request, copy the link, and watch the lifecycle in real time. State is in-process and resets on cold start — this is a demo, not a billing system.
clerk.listCount: {count, plural, =0 {0 requests} one {1 request} other {# requests}}
clerk.emptyHint: Create one with the form on the right, or try a preset.

form.title: New request
form.externalRefHint: Your case, ticket, or invoice number.
form.descriptionHint: Visible to the payer on the pay page.
form.payerEmailHint: Used to mock email delivery. Provide at least one.
form.createdHint: Copy the URL to send via your SMS gateway or email, or open it now to preview the payer flow.

detail.payLinkHint: Signed single-use URL. Anyone with this link can pay this exact amount for this exact reference, once.
detail.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? The payer's link will stop working.

pay.trustFootnote: This pay link is signed and single-use. No card number is ever typed — you authorize from your own bank. Mocked for demonstration.
pay.invalidBody: The payment link is malformed or its signature doesn't check out. Ask the sender for a fresh link.
pay.expiredBody: The payment window for this request has closed. Contact the municipal office to get a new link.
pay.goneBody: This demo's state is ephemeral and resets on server restart. The link is signed correctly, but the request behind it no longer exists. Create a new one from the clerk dashboard.
pay.cancelledBody: The clerk cancelled this payment request. Nothing is owed against this link.
pay.alreadyPaidBody: This bill was paid on {paidAt}. Confirmation number {confirmation}.

flow.pickBankHint: Choose your financial institution. You'll authorize the payment there — this page never sees your credentials.
flow.authorizingSubtitle: In the real flow, you'd approve this inside your banking app right now.
flow.authorizingMockNote: Mocked bank authorization — auto-approves in a moment
flow.paidSubtitle: {amount} sent. The clerk's dashboard already shows it.
flow.paidFootnote: Keep the confirmation number. In the real flow, your bank also sends its own receipt.
flow.errorHint: Refresh the page to see the current state of this request.

error.not-found: Request not found — demo state may have reset
error.expired: This request expired before payment completed
